fields.description: Off records the coordinates but never refuses a punch. Off by default: a phone punch is taken from anywhere.
fields.label: Enforce Geofence

fields.description: Used when a Work Location leaves its own radius blank.
fields.label: Default Radius (metres)

fields.description: A phone punch with no coordinate is refused. Off records it as no_location and lets it through.
fields.label: Require Location For Mobile Punches

fields.description: A device_id starting with this is a fingerprint machine: bolted to a wall, so never geofenced and never re-stamped with the server clock.
fields.label: Trusted Device Prefix
Punch Window
fields.description: Binds self-service phone punches only. Machine punches and approved regularizations are exempt, because both legitimately record times other than now.

Factor HR's Sandwich Leave: a weekend or holiday run with leave or absence on the working day immediately either side of it is counted as leave too. Off until HR confirms the policy group-wide — see docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.
fields.label: Enable Sandwich Leave

fields.description: The Form's own share link — what the Onboarding page's Share Google Form button hands to an employee. Not read for anything else: this box is never used to fetch a submission.
fields.label: Google Form URL

fields.description: The id in the linked Sheet's URL, between /d/ and /edit. That Sheet is what Sync Now reads — not the Form.
fields.label: Google Sheet ID

fields.description: A Google OAuth client's id, from a Desktop app OAuth client on the same GCP project — not a service account. Used with the refresh token below rather than a service-account key, because this project's org policy (iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation) refuses to create one. See tools/google_form_oauth.py for getting the refresh token.
fields.label: OAuth Client ID

fields.description: Long-lived — obtained once by signing in as a Google account that can read the Sheet, and good until that account revokes it. Run tools/google_form_oauth.py on your own machine (never on the bench) to get one; it opens a browser, asks you to sign in and consent, and prints the token to paste here.
fields.label: OAuth Refresh Token

fields.description: Set by Sync Now, never typed. Empty means the Sheet has not been read yet.
fields.label: Last Synced

fields.description: Set from the dashboard's Settings → Security, not typed here: which modules and pages every login is shown, as only what differs from the build's defaults — {"employees/all": "show", "leave": "hide"}. A menu, not a permission. Only the logins in manna_hr/rules.py PAGE_ADMINS may change it.
fields.label: Page Visibility

fields.description: Set from the dashboard's Settings → Security → Employee fields, not typed here: which Employee fields each login may only read, or is not shown, on Create Employee ("new") and on Employee Profile ("edit") — {"new": {"attendance_device_id": "read"}, "edit": {"ctc": "hidden"}}. The site refuses a change to either; hidden is also taken off the forms. Binds every login except manna_hr/rules.py PAGE_ADMINS.
fields.label: Employee Field Access
